name: Start-Up Residence Programme

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum EUR25,000 paid-up share capital in the Maltese start-up entity.
requirements.fix_path: Capitalise the Maltese entity to at least EUR25,000 paid-up share capital.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be founder/co-founder of a company registered no more than 7 years anywhere globally, with a business plan approved by Malta Enterprise in an eligible sector (manufacturing, software development, health/biotech/pharma/life sciences, or blue/green/sustainable 'eco startups'), meeting at least two of: income-generation potential from multiple geographic markets, a novel or substantially improved product/service, or a novel or substantially improved process.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain Malta Enterprise approval of a qualifying business plan.

evidence_required.document: Proof of EUR25,000 paid-up share capital
Health insurance covering all risks (applicant and dependants)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the tier-3 sourcing reviewed in this pass
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: founder must relocate and take up tax residence in Malta

sources.title: KPMG Malta -- The Malta Start-Up Residence Programme: eligibility, EUR25,000 paid-up capital, Malta Enterprise business-plan approval criteria, relocation/tax-residence requirement
